item.title: X replaces its revenue-sharing program with ‘Original Content Rewards’
item.description: X is ending its controversial revenue-sharing program for content creators, which has seen numerous revisions under Elon Musk's reign. In its place, it's launching a new Original Content Rewards program on September 8th.
